summary: Rocket One Inc. filed an 8-K on May 28, 2026, announcing an increase in the maximum aggregate offering price under its existing at-the-market (ATM) equity sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The increase is for up to $2,661,176, bringing total potential ATM capacity higher; approximately $6,618,059 in shares have been sold to date. The filing also notes acceptance into AMD's AI Developer Program via a press release dated May 28. This is a routine capital markets activity—an ordinary shelf takedown or ATM program adjustment—not a transformative special situation. No structural change, premium, tender, or activist event is involved.
